title: CandidatePackage
description: The unit a Reviewer adjudicates: a task ref, the plan it was produced under, the produced outputs, declared acceptance checks, and provenance. Carries a SANITIZATION CONTRACT: the reviewer-visible projection (`sanitized_view`) MUST exclude author self-assessment prose, confidence assertions, and 'refined/final/expert' labels, because those framings shift verdicts ~18-29pp (intake-837/838). Sanitization is applied at package-assembly time, not at reviewer-prompt time. Immutable once assembled; only `status` mutates.

package_id.description: Unique identifier for this candidate package.

status.description: Mutable status field (immutable-structure/mutable-status, intake-846). All other fields are append/versioned.

task_ref.description: task_id of the TaskIR this candidate answers.

plan_ref.description: Reference to the plan/ArchitectureIR the candidate was produced under (task_id or arch name@version).

objective.description: Neutral restatement of the objective (safe for the reviewer view).

outputs.description: The produced artifacts under review (domain-general: diffs, files, answers, summaries).

acceptance_checks.description: Declared, checkable acceptance criteria (mirror of TaskIR.definition_of_done).

author_self_assessment.description: OPTIONAL author-supplied self-assessment prose. MUST be stripped from sanitized_view — retained on the full package for audit only.

author_confidence_assertion.description: OPTIONAL author-asserted confidence. MUST be stripped from sanitized_view (framing-neutrality, intake-837).

quality_labels.description: OPTIONAL author labels (e.g. 'refined', 'final', 'expert'). MUST be stripped from sanitized_view.

context_refs.description: v1.1 (spec §4.3/§6.1/§13.3). Content-addressed pointers to the ONLY context the reviewer is shown: relevant source spans, IRs, prior reports. Each ref is a `blob:sha256:...` hash (optionally with a span suffix) — full history is retrieved only via a typed evidence request, shrinking context cost + prompt-injection surface. Enables the §12.4 replay query to reconstruct the exact reviewed package from hashes.

verification_report_refs.description: v1.1 (spec §6.1). report_ids / content addresses of the VerificationReports attached to this package.

ref.description: Locator or inline content id for the output.

verifier.description: Objective verifier that can decide this check (gate/scorer/checker id), if any.

subject.description: v1.1 (spec §6.1). Content-addressed identity of what is under review. These hashes are the material inputs the DecisionEnvelope binds to (§6.6 subject) and that automatic invalidation (§12.3) watches — a change to any of them invalidates a prior decision.

artifact_hash.description: sha256 of the produced artifact under review (the integrated patch / answer / proof).

specification_hash.description: sha256 of the task specification / acceptance criteria.

plan_hash.description: sha256 of the plan / ArchitectureIR the candidate was produced under.

untrusted_content_policy.description: v1.1 (spec §5-security / §6.1 / §13). The candidate artifact is attacker-controlled input from the reviewer's perspective, EVEN when produced by a trusted local model. This block declares the control/data separation contract the package builder enforces: candidate text is data, embedded instructions are ignored, and any authority claim ('tests passed', 'a human approved') has ZERO weight without a trusted ledger evidence id.

candidate_text_is_data.description: Candidate content is placed in explicitly delimited data fields; it is never interpreted as reviewer instructions (§13.1 control/data separation).

candidate_instructions_ignored.description: Any 'ignore the reviewer policy'-style instruction embedded in the candidate/retrieved text is inert (§13.1).

authority_claims_require_ledger_proof.description: Textual claims of prior verification/approval resolve to authority ONLY through a hash-verified ledger evidence id (§13.1 evidence-must-resolve-through-the-ledger).

context_ref.description: v1.1 (spec §6.1). A single content-addressed context pointer.

ref.description: Content address, e.g. 'blob:sha256:<hex>' or 'blob:sha256:<hex>#L20-L150'. Bound to a hash so the reviewer cannot be shown different bytes than were decided on (§13.3).

provenance.description: Reproducibility record for the AUTHOR of the candidate.

flag_state.description: Relevant runtime-flag values at generation time.

instrument_era.description: instrument_eras.yaml era label active at generation time.

sanitized_view.description: REVIEWER-VISIBLE PROJECTION. This is the ONLY view a Reviewer is shown. It MUST NOT contain author self-assessment prose, confidence assertions, or 'refined/final/expert' quality labels (the fields author_self_assessment / author_confidence_assertion / quality_labels are excluded by construction). Framing-neutral by contract.

context_refs.description: v1.1. Content-addressed context the reviewer is shown (mirror of the top-level field — this is the reviewer-visible projection).

applied.description: True once the sanitization projection has been applied at assembly time.

removed_fields.description: Field names stripped from the full package (audit trail).

policy_version.description: Version of the sanitization policy applied.

path_allowlist.description: CP3 §13.2 control 6. Repo-relative prefixes a candidate output `ref` file locator may point at; an output ref outside this set is dropped from the reviewer view (recorded in `redactions`).

redactions.description: CP3 §13.2 control 6. Audit trail of content the assembly sanitizer withheld from the reviewer view: out-of-allowlist file locators DROPPED, and secret-like tokens MASKED in retained inline content. Redaction is FLAGGED here, never silent. Only the redaction category is recorded — never the secret value.

index.description: Index of the affected output in the original (pre-sanitization) outputs array.

category.description: path_allowlist = out-of-package file locator dropped; secret = secret-like token masked in retained content.

original_type.description: output_ref type of a dropped out-of-allowlist output.

patterns.description: Secret-pattern categories matched (e.g. private_key, openai_key). Never the secret value.

truncation_manifest.description: CP3 §13.2 controls 5,7. Present only when the reviewer-output retention cap dropped material — records what was dropped so nothing critical is SILENTLY truncated. Material/risk-flagged outputs are prioritized into the retained set; the manifest is the audit trail for the remainder.

output_cap.description: Retention cap applied (matches the downstream reviewer render cap).

total_outputs.description: Number of outputs before the retention cap.

retained.description: Number of outputs kept in the reviewer view.

dropped.description: Outputs dropped by the retention cap (lowest materiality first-dropped).

digest.description: Truncated sha256 of the dropped output ref (retrievable via a typed evidence request).

ref_preview.description: Short, redaction-safe preview of the dropped output ref.
